name: Avila's El Ranchito
tagline: Hearty homestyle Mexican recipes, Mama Avila’s soup, and celebrated margaritas
description: A beloved family legacy since 1966, Avila’s El Ranchito serves timeless Guanajuato recipes in an inviting historic home setting. Locals flock here for Mama Avila’s famous chicken soup, sizzling fajita skillets, carnitas plates, and signature Cadillac margaritas made with fresh citrus juices.
historicNote: Occupies a historic 1915 California Craftsman bungalow complete with cobblestone pathways, vintage ceramic lanterns, and a courtyard patio.

specials.title: Margarita Monday

specials.title: Sizzling Fajita Thursday

specials.title: Fiesta Happy Hour

specials.title: Weekend Menudo & Carnitas
